#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int from, to, capacity, cost, flow;
    Edge *rev;
    Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) : from(from), to(to), capacity(capacity), cost(cost), flow(0), rev(nullptr) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge*>> compileWD(int n, vector<Edge>& edges) {
    vector<Edge> allEdges = edges;
    for (int i = (int)allEdges.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Edge &e = allEdges[i];
        Edge rev(e.to, e.from, e.capacity, -e.cost);
        rev.flow = e.capacity;
        Edge *revPtr = new Edge(rev);
        e.rev = revPtr;
        revPtr->rev = &e;
        allEdges.push_back(rev);
    }
    vector<int> p(n, 0);
    for (auto &e : allEdges) p[e.from]++;
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g(n);
    vector<int> idx(n, 0);
    for (auto &e : allEdges) {
        g[e.from][idx[e.from]++] = &e;
    }
    return g;
}

long long minCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge*>> &g, int s, int t, int flowNeeded) {
    int n = (int)g.size();
    long long totalCost = 0;
    vector<long long> dist(n);
    vector<long long> potential(n);
    vector<Edge*> parent(n, nullptr);
    while (flowNeeded > 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dist[i] = LLONG_MAX / 2;
        dist[s] = 0;
        std::priority_queue<std::pair<long long,int>, std::vector<std::pair<long long,int>>, std::greater<>> pq;
        pq.emplace(0, s);
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (d > dist[u]) continue;
            for (auto e : g[u]) {
                if (e->capacity - e->flow > 0) {
                    long long nd = d + e->cost + potential[u] - potential[e->to];
                    if (dist[e->to] > nd) {
                        parent[e->to] = e;
                        dist[e->to] = nd;
                        pq.emplace(nd, e->to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (parent[t] == nullptr) break;
        int pushFlow = flowNeeded;
        for (Edge *e = parent[t]; e != nullptr; e = parent[e->from]) {
            pushFlow = std::min(pushFlow, e->capacity - e->flow);
        }
        long long cost = 0;
        for (Edge *e = parent[t]; e != nullptr; e = parent[e->from]) {
            e->flow += pushFlow;
            e->rev->flow -= pushFlow;
            cost += (long long) e->cost * pushFlow;
        }
        totalCost += cost;
        flowNeeded -= pushFlow;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (dist[i] < LLONG_MAX / 2) {
                potential[i] += dist[i];
            }
        }
    }
    return totalCost;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    string line; cin >> line;
    vector<char> s(line.begin(), line.end());

    vector<int> freq(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) freq[c - 'a']++;
    for (int count : freq) {
        if (count > n / 2) {
            cout << -1 << "\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> a[i];

    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        if (a[i] > a[n - 1 - i]) {
            std::swap(a[i], a[n - 1 - i]);
            std::swap(s[i], s[n - 1 - i]);
        }
    }

    vector<Edge> edges;
    int source = n, sink = n + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        edges.emplace_back(source, i, 1, 0);
        edges.emplace_back(n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
                int costVal = (i == j) ? 0 : a[i];
                edges.emplace_back(i, n - 1 - j, 1, costVal);
            }
        }
    }

    long long totalSum = 0;
    for (int val : a) totalSum += val;
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g = compileWD(sink + 1, edges);
    long long minCost = minCostFlow(g, source, sink, n);
    cout << totalSum - minCost << "\n";

    return 0;
}
